Container.Name: obsidian-sync-station-beta
Container.Overview: BETA CHANNEL. Pre-release builds from the beta branch, published for testing before they are released. They may break. For daily use install the stable entry obsidian-sync-station instead. This entry can run next to the stable one: it defaults to port 8494 and to separate -beta paths. Never point it at the same Config or Vault path as the stable container. Two sync clients writing into one vault folder cause sync conflicts and can lose data. Keeps an Obsidian vault synced using Obsidian's official headless Sync client (ob), with an optional local backup to your server storage. Configure everything from the web UI: Obsidian login (email/password/MFA), remote vault selection, optional end-to-end decryption password, and sync status. LAN-only by design: the web UI holds your Obsidian credentials, so do NOT expose it to the internet. Requires an active Obsidian Sync subscription. The proprietary ob client is installed from npm on first start (not bundled). Give the container its own dedicated vault path and never point the Obsidian desktop app at the same path. Backup: set Enable Backup to true and map the Backup path to enable scheduled tar.gz snapshots (schedule + retention configured in the web UI). Optional off-site backups via restic and ntfy notifications are supported.
Container.Description: BETA channel (pre-release builds for testing). Web UI + container for syncing an Obsidian vault via the official headless client, with optional local backups, off-site restic backups, mirror, restore and ntfy notifications. Built for Unraid.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI (container listens on 8080). 8080 is often taken on Unraid, the stable entry uses 8484, so this beta entry defaults to 8494. Change it if needed. LAN-only, do not expose to the internet.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent state: settings, GUI password, Obsidian login + the ob client install. Must NOT be the appdata folder of the stable container.

Config.Name: Vault
Config.Description: The synced vault files. Use a DEDICATED path only this container writes to. Never point the Obsidian desktop app here at the same time, and never share it with the stable obsidian-sync-station container: two sync clients on one vault folder cause conflicts. Best used with a separate test vault.

Config.Name: Backup
Config.Description: Snapshot target on your server storage. Only used when Enable Backup is true. Keep it separate from the stable container's backup path.

Config.Name: Enable Backup
Config.Description: Set to true to enable scheduled backups and show backup options in the web UI.

Config.Name: Device Name
Config.Description: Label shown in the Obsidian Sync history.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Default 99 (nobody) so synced files stay usable by other containers. Set to 0 to run as root like versions up to 0.5.6.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as. Default 100 (users), the Unraid share convention.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File mode mask for everything the container writes. 0002 gives 0664 files and 0775 folders, so the group keeps write access.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone. Drives the backup schedule and all timestamps shown in the web UI.

Config.Name: Mirror snapshots
Config.Description: Set to true to also copy each snapshot to a second destination (map the Mirror path).

Config.Name: Mirror
Config.Description: Second snapshot destination. Only used when Mirror snapshots is true. Point this at another disk/share for an off-box copy. Keep it separate from the stable container's mirror path.

Config.Name: ntfy URL
Config.Description: Optional ntfy topic URL for push notifications (also settable in the web UI), e.g. https://ntfy.example.com/obsidian.

Config.Name: ntfy token
Config.Description: Optional ntfy access token (Bearer) for auth-protected ntfy servers. Leave empty for public topics. Also settable in the web UI.

Config.Name: restic repository
Config.Description: Optional off-site backup via restic. Use a different repository than the stable container. Local example: /backup/restic. Cloud: s3:s3.amazonaws.com/bucket, b2:bucket:path, sftp:user@host:/path. For cloud, add the backend credential variables too (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, B2_ACCOUNT_ID/B2_ACCOUNT_KEY, ...) via Add another Path/Port/Variable.

Config.Name: restic password
Config.Description: Encryption password for the restic repository. Required when restic repository is set. Keep it safe: the repo cannot be read without it.
